info.name: CacheDB postgresql Tenant Purge - Isolated Native INITIAL
info.description: SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED_RUNTIME_UNQUALIFIED. Disposable schema only. One explicit purge POST; no retries, poll loops or reopen. Run through the companion wrapper with redirects disabled. Foreign Redis evidence is an encrypted sentinel, not a separately enrolled foreign runtime.

exec: const base = pm.environment.get('baseUrl');
if (typeof base !== 'string' || !/^http:\/\/[A-Za-z0-9.-]+(?::[0-9]{1,5})?$/.test(base)) { throw new Error('Explicit private disposable HTTP origin required'); }
if (!/^[0-9a-f]{32}$/.test(pm.environment.get('purgeRunId') || '')) { throw new Error('Fresh run ID required'); }
if (!/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{32,128}$/.test(pm.environment.get('purgeAdminToken') || '')) { throw new Error('Bounded admin token required'); }
if (!/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/.test(pm.environment.get('purgeOperationId') || '')) { throw new Error('Explicit operation UUID required'); }
pm.test('No redirects', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.code >= 300 && pm.response.code < 400).to.eql(false); pm.expect(pm.response.headers.has('Location')).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('No credential output', function () { const token = pm.environment.get('purgeAdminToken'); pm.expect(typeof token === 'string' && !pm.response.text().includes(token)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 401', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(401); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 403', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const value = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Actual two-root INITIAL state', function () { pm.expect(value.actualRoots).to.eql(2); pm.expect(value.phase).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(value.sqlGate).to.eql('OPEN'); pm.expect(value.redisGate).to.eql('OPEN'); pm.expect(value.sqlGeneration).to.eql(1); pm.expect(value.redisGeneration).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Bounded owned SQL and hot state', function () { pm.expect(value.ownedSqlRows).to.eql(7); pm.expect(value.hotOwnedRows).to.eql(2); pm.expect(value.coldAbsentFromRedis).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Foreign SQL and encrypted Redis sentinel preserved', function () { pm.expect(value.foreignSqlPreserved).to.eql(true); pm.expect(value.foreignRedisPreserved).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test('Owned hot row delivered', function () { const row = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(row.id).to.eql(1); pm.expect(row.present).to.eql(true); pm.expect(Object.keys(row).sort()).to.eql(['id', 'present']); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const value = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Actual two-root CLOSED state', function () { pm.expect(value.actualRoots).to.eql(2); pm.expect(value.phase).to.eql('COMPLETE'); pm.expect(value.sqlGate).to.eql('CLOSED'); pm.expect(value.redisGate).to.eql('CLOSED'); pm.expect(value.sqlGeneration).to.eql(1); pm.expect(value.redisGeneration).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Bounded owned SQL and hot state', function () { pm.expect(value.ownedSqlRows).to.eql(0); pm.expect(value.hotOwnedRows).to.eql(0); pm.expect(value.coldAbsentFromRedis).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Foreign SQL and encrypted Redis sentinel preserved', function () { pm.expect(value.foreignSqlPreserved).to.eql(true); pm.expect(value.foreignRedisPreserved).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Include-source purge retains security metadata', function () { pm.expect(value.purgedSqlRows).to.eql(7); pm.expect(value.securityMetadataRetained).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 200', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const value = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Actual two-root CLOSED state', function () { pm.expect(value.actualRoots).to.eql(2); pm.expect(value.phase).to.eql('COMPLETE'); pm.expect(value.sqlGate).to.eql('CLOSED'); pm.expect(value.redisGate).to.eql('CLOSED'); pm.expect(value.sqlGeneration).to.eql(1); pm.expect(value.redisGeneration).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Bounded owned SQL and hot state', function () { pm.expect(value.ownedSqlRows).to.eql(0); pm.expect(value.hotOwnedRows).to.eql(0); pm.expect(value.coldAbsentFromRedis).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Foreign SQL and encrypted Redis sentinel preserved', function () { pm.expect(value.foreignSqlPreserved).to.eql(true); pm.expect(value.foreignRedisPreserved).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Include-source purge retains security metadata', function () { pm.expect(value.purgedSqlRows).to.eql(7); pm.expect(value.securityMetadataRetained).to.eql(true); });
pm.test('Exact HTTP 409', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(409); });
